rows.title: MATS is owner-write-only
rows.defect: the MATS registry entry allows AI drafting
rows.test: MATS refused, assistance offered

rows.title: Context ban wins
rows.defect: the explicit context ban is not read
rows.test: a context-recorded ban refuses outreach

rows.title: UNKNOWN defaults closed
rows.defect: personal statements default to AI_OK
rows.test: an unchecked statement kind is UNKNOWN

rows.title: Disclosure flag carried
rows.defect: the disclosure flag is dropped from the verdict
rows.test: a disclose-policy verdict carries disclosureRequired

rows.title: Cold start is null
rows.defect: an empty sample list synthesizes a profile
rows.test: no samples means no profile

rows.title: Too thin is null
rows.defect: a single sentence is enough for a profile
rows.test: two sentences are too thin for a profile

rows.title: Short share measured
rows.defect: sentences of six words or fewer are never counted short
rows.test: bursty samples show a short-sentence share

rows.title: Per-audience profiles
rows.defect: per-audience sub-profiles are never built
rows.test: two audiences produce two sub-profiles

rows.title: Assigned opening honored
rows.defect: the assigned opening mode is ignored
rows.test: an assigned opening mode is the seed's mode

rows.title: Prompt carries the voice
rows.defect: the voice block is rendered empty
rows.test: the rendered prompt contains the voice targets

rows.title: Numbers trace
rows.defect: the fact corpus's numbers are never collected
rows.test: a faithful draft's numbers all trace

rows.title: Fact-lock hard-fails invention
rows.defect: the tracer reports every span traced
rows.test: an invented $40 million is named untraced

rows.title: Substance floor
rows.defect: the substance floor is two words
rows.test: a 3-word text is below the draft minimum

rows.title: Hard-banned opener
rows.defect: the finds-you-well opener is not on the hard list
rows.test: 'i hope this email finds you well' is a hard hit

rows.title: Two markers fail
rows.defect: any number of marker words passes the metric
rows.test: delve + tapestry together fail the metric

rows.title: Uniform run fails
rows.defect: a uniform run of any length passes
rows.test: six same-length sentences show a run of 6

rows.title: Profile-relative CV bar
rows.defect: the CV bar is a tenth of the profile's own CV
rows.test: a flat draft fails against a CV-1.0 profile

rows.title: Tricolons are tells
rows.defect: tricolons are never counted as tells
rows.test: two tricolon sentences fail tells

rows.title: Anchor density
rows.defect: unanchored paragraphs are never collected
rows.test: an unanchored long paragraph is named

rows.title: Still-failing is flagged
rows.defect: a still-failing draft returns unflagged
rows.test: an unfixable draft returns flagged with metrics

rows.title: Instruction from scorecard
rows.defect: the rewrite loop passes an empty instruction
rows.test: the second generation receives the scorecard's instruction

rows.title: HS-1 verbatim reuse
rows.defect: verbatim reuse is tolerated at any share
rows.test: a sentence in 4 of 4 drafts fails reuse

rows.title: HS-3 same-firm subject dup
rows.defect: same-firm subject duplicates are never detected
rows.test: an identical subject at one firm is flagged

rows.title: HS-4 length spread
rows.defect: a length ratio of 1 passes the spread check
rows.test: eight equal-length drafts fail at ratio 1

rows.title: HS-6 logistics repetition
rows.defect: logistics repetition is tolerated at any share
rows.test: one logistics string in 4 of 4 drafts fails

rows.title: Edit capture counts
rows.defect: captured edits are never counted
rows.test: one captured edit makes basis.edits 1

rows.title: Generator ships the ask
rows.defect: the composed draft never appends its ask
rows.test: a composed draft contains the logistics ask

rows.title: Opener classes
rows.defect: question openers are never classified as questions
rows.test: a question opener classifies as question
